Diseases of the Retina and Posterior Segment

blocks.text: Diseases of the Retina and Posterior Segment

Main diseases of the retina that because blindness are Diabetic Retinopathy, Diabetic Macular Edema, Retinal Detachment, Vitreous Hemorrhages, retinal vessels occlusions and Age-related Macular Degeneration.
